title: Self-Pay Visit Package Renewal Rates: Prompt Renewals and Renewals After Forfeits
content:
**Rate card — renewal discount on a Self-Pay Visit Package bought again in the same tier.** The renewal discount changes in two situations:

- a **prompt renewal**, bought no later than half of the tier's renewal window in calendar days after the exhaustion where no visit of the exhausted package was forfeited, carries **10 percent**;
- a renewal bought within the tier's renewal window of the exhaustion where at least one visit of the exhausted package was forfeited carries **3 percent**.

In any other case neither rate applies.

**Day figures by tier.** The days are counted as calendar days from the exhaustion date recorded on the exhausted package to the purchase date.

| Tier | Renewal window | Prompt renewal: no later than | Renewal with a forfeit: no later than |
|---|---|---|---|
| Recovery 6-Visit, Core 8-Visit, Complete 12-Visit, Comprehensive 24-Visit Packages | 30 days | 15 days after the exhaustion | 30 days after the exhaustion |
| Starter 4-Visit and Post-Surgical 18-Visit Packages | 0 days | 0 days — the exhaustion date itself | 0 days — the exhaustion date itself |

**Forfeits.** A visit of the exhausted package was forfeited where that package's history carries a forfeit entry for a late cancellation or a no-show.

**Day-count cases (hypothetical, a tier with a 30-day window)**

| Days after the exhaustion | Forfeits on the exhausted package | Rate under this card |
|---|---|---|
| 15 | none | 10 percent — the boundary day qualifies |
| 16 | none | neither rate |
| 10 | one | 3 percent |
| 30 | two | 3 percent — the boundary day qualifies |
| 31 | one | neither rate |
